# P34.10 — One allow-listed publish path (no hand rsync; never deletes release trees)

**Requirement ids (owner §56):** **`SIG-OPS-003`**, **`SIG-OPS-004`** ·
**cited:** `SIG-REL-004` (refines SIG-OPS-004 once the release tool exists —
P35.53), `SIG-REL-009` (page release id; P35.13) ·
**Base:** `r11/P34.9-ledger-contract-validator-no-vacuous-pass` (chain tip —
merge after it) ·
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/212_P34.10__one-allow-listed-publish-path.md`
(manifest row 212 — Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) ·
**Owns:** S0 F-02 (durable fix), S1 F-160, F-277 ·
**Live stage:** **none** — code + tests only; the first `--apply` is P34.17's
republish L2 under its own verbatim go. `live_verification=false`.

## Why

The 2026-09-27 republish was executed with a hand-typed
`gcloud storage rsync -r --delete-unmatched-destination-objects` (S0 F-02,
`docs/build/planning/2026-09-30-next-phase/research/G1-ops.md` §3.2): it
bypassed every build exclusion, re-published `/curate/**` to the public
origin, and nothing verified the denied routes afterwards because no probe
could express "must be absent". This ticket removes the hand path: public
bytes reach a public bucket only through `sig-ops publish-web`.

## What this does

1. **The default web build emits only the public surface.** Internal route
   sources moved `web/src/pages/{curate,releases,research-dossier,
   contribution-back,visual-language}` → `web/src/internal/` and are injected
   by a new `sigInternalRoutes` Astro integration (`injectRoute`, Astro 7.x)
   **only when `SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL=1`**. The web e2e suite
   (`playwright.config.ts` webServer) and `check:perf` (whose budget matrix
   audits `/curate/index.html`) set the flag; a publishable build never does.
   `strip_non_public_web` stays as belt-and-suspenders.
2. **A committed allow-list — `ops/public_routes.toml`** (data, not code):
   `[allowlist].top_level` names every publishable top-level entry incl.
   `/data-collection/` (P35.38a, S6c); `/curate/`, `/intake/`,
   `/contribution-back/`, `/visual-language/`, `/releases/`,
   `/research-dossier/` and the `demo_*` task pages stay off it (C-12,
   "Accept the list", A-0.3 = b). `required` names the subset every build
   MUST emit — an allow-list over a silently-incomplete build fails too.
   `[[denied]]` names the six never-public routes (`/curate/`,
   `/curate/submit/`, `/task/new/demo_roundtrip/`, `/releases/`,
   `/research-dossier/`, `/intake/`). `load_allowlist` fails closed on a
   missing/empty file and refuses a nonexistent *explicit* path rather than
   substituting the default.
3. **Tree + content assertions** (`ops/publish.py`):
   `assert_allowlisted_tree` refuses any top-level entry off the list (or a
   missing required one); `assert_public_tree_content` refuses
   `data-testid="curate-auth-banner"`, a form action on a loopback host
   (127.0.0.1 / localhost / 0.0.0.0 / ::1), `demo_` path segments, `demo_`
   hrefs and rendered `demo_` task-field ids — all before any write.
4. **A release record** — `write_release_record` emits
   `dist/.sig-release.json` (`sig/web-release-record/1.0.0`): release id
   (`web-<utc>-<commit>` default), `git rev-parse HEAD`, `date -u` build
   time, `sha256:` tree digest over the sorted (relpath, sha256) manifest of
   every synced byte except the record itself, `image_digests` (recorded
   empty for a static site), and `data_release` linking the export's own
   release id when the prepare leg ran.
5. **One repository-owned sync** — `sync_tree` over the injectable
   `GcsBucket` (new `delete_object` added for exactly this caller): the site
   tree syncs with remote-extra deletion EXCEPT the protected release
   namespaces `r/`, `releases/`, `entity/`, `conf/` and the release-pipeline
   root objects (`compat_index.json`, `release.json`) — `plan_site_sync`
   never lists them in `deletes` (they are reported as `protected_kept`,
   audited not silent), and `is_protected_object` re-checks every delete at
   the write. A staged release tree (`--release-tree`, restricted to release
   namespaces by `assert_release_tree`) and the public-compartment tree
   (`--public-tree` → `--public-bucket`) sync append-only in the SAME run —
   a publish never deletes a release tree or a compartment byte.
   `deploy.py`'s plan now names `sig-ops publish-web` for the public buckets;
   the restricted-side rsync stays operator-executed and is labelled so.
   `ops/README.md` carries the note forbidding hand-typed syncs to public
   buckets.
6. **Post-sync absence proof.** `http-absent` probe kind (`observe.http_absent`
   + `probe_hosted`): GREEN iff the route answers exactly 404 — a 200/3xx/403
   is "present" and an unreachable origin is a failure (absence cannot be
   proven against a dead origin). `ops/cadence.toml` carries 18 targets — the
   six denied routes × three public origins (apex `surveillancegraph.org`,
   `$SIG_PROBE_WEB_URL`, `storage.googleapis.com/{project}-sig-web`) — picked
   up by the 6-hourly `sig-probe` sweep and run at-once as the publish's
   post-sync verify. `resolve_targets` now appends `path` to literal-URL
   targets (previously only `url_env` targets got it — literal-origin probes
   were hitting the bare root; caught by the new tests). `--apply` refuses
   when no absence probe resolved, and when any denied route answers
   non-404. The alert wording distinguishes a failed absence probe ("denied
   route … is RED on a public origin") from an ordinary DOWN.

## Verification

- `uv run pytest tests/ops` — **669 passed, 1 skipped** (Dockerless web-iac
  case), incl. 24 new P34.10 tests across `test_publish.py`,
  `test_scheduled.py`, `test_observe.py`, `test_deploy.py`: allow-list
  parsing/refusals (planted `curate/`, unlisted dir/file, missing required
  route), content markers (banner, loopback action, `demo_` page + slug),
  release-record fields + digest reproducibility, protected-namespace sync
  plans (never deleted; staged tree survives a redeploy; refuses a plan that
  would), dry-run writes nothing remote, apply syncs once + probes,
  absent-verify refusal on present/zero coverage, denied↔probe coverage on
  every origin, `http_absent` status truth table, CLI dry-run/apply guards.
- `SIG_GCP_PROJECT=sentinel-project-000 uv run pytest` (full non-Docker
  suite, armed leak gate) — **5869 passed, 386 skipped, 0 failed**; every
  skip is a Docker-daemon-absence skip (`tests/db`, `tests/e2e`,
  `test_web_iac`) — no Docker on this machine, so the claim-spine and
  composed-stack suites did not run here (environmental, not a regression).
- `uv run pytest tests/ops/test_publish.py -k 'web_build or internal_build'`
  — real `npm run build` executed twice: **no `curate/`** (nor any other
  non-public route) without the flag; `SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL=1` restores the
  full internal surface. (The route gate lives in `astro.config.mjs`,
  orthogonal to `SIG_DATA_SOURCE`; `exports/out/` is gitignored so CI has no
  export bundle to build against — the publish path composes this same gate
  after `build_public_web`.)
- `npm --prefix web run typecheck` — 0 errors (149 files);
  `npm --prefix web run test:unit` — 271 passed;
  `npm --prefix web run check:licenses` — all 221 production dependencies
  pass the OSI/permissive gate.
- `npx playwright test curate.spec.ts` — **6 passed** (the e2e webServer
  rebuilds `web/dist` with `SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL=1`, proving the internal
  routes still serve under the flag); `npm run check:perf` — Lighthouse
  8 URLs × 3 runs, all assertions pass incl. `/curate/index.html`.
- `ruff check` / `ruff format --check` / `mypy` — clean (300 source files).
- `make verify-gen` — regenerated artifacts byte-identical
  (`git diff --exit-code -- pylock.toml ontology/generated` clean).
- `make docs-check` — all detectors green; the COVERAGE_MATRIX evidence-path

  regenerated via `current_projection.py generate` — `verify: fresh —
  933/933 input digests`.
- `make check` — run locally before commit (see the `ci:` line for the
  head-bound record). `live_verification=false`: no `--apply`, no bucket
  mutation, no live probe ran — all sync/probe behaviour is fixture- and

## Deferred (not claimed)

- The live route set equal to the allow-list and the absence probes green on
  every origin — **P34.17 L2** (layer: public). The `http-absent` machinery
  is engineered + fixture-verified here; nothing ran against production.
- The release tool owning `/releases/index.html` end-to-end — **P35.53**
  (SIG-REL-004); the protected-prefix + `RELEASE_TREE_TOP_LEVEL` contract is
  its seam.
- Withdrawn-surface absence probes beyond the six contracted routes
  (`/contribution-back/`, `/visual-language/` are off the allow-list but not
  in the ticket's [[denied]] set) — the denied list is data; adding a row
  probes it.

## Size

≈ 2,170 changed lines (~630 publish.py, ~210 cli.py, ~750 tests, ~120
cadence rows, ~110 allow-list, web config + page renames, ~20 build-memory
maintenance lines for COVERAGE_MATRIX/current-projection) — under the
≤ 3,000 budget.
